newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei jumps two pct in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei jumps two pct in early morning.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index jumped more than two percent in early morning trade on Tuesday, as recent buying momentum was reinforced by Wall Street stocks' record rally on Monday.
Brokers said a rising trend in blue-chip issues continued, with Sony Corp's shares hitting a record high of 9,510 yen ($74) soon after the opening.
After 27 minutes of trade the 225-share Nikkei average had climbed 492.25 points or 2.52 percent to 20,007.00. It was the first time the Nikkei had topped 20,000 since mid-December.
June Nikkei futures were up 540 at 20,070.
